title: Q-YEAR-SIM-github-down: its recovery is declared but no drill exercises code
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** the year simulation (YEAR-SIM-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe github-down
**Status:** closed

Fault class `github-down`: its recovery is declared but no drill exercises code. Drill evidence: while GitHub is down nothing merges anywhere; the loops resume from the repository when it returns (declared, not exercised)

Build the mechanism that recovers from it without a person, then the drill in foundation/yearsim.py must exercise it.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe github-down` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-22T01:33:12Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
